heroVideo.sampleLabel: Illustrative film with sample products, shopping screens and results. Not live results or guaranteed outcomes.
heroVideo.transcriptIntroduction: On-screen text and visual action from the 58-second film. Scene times are approximate. This is a visual transcript, not a transcription of speech.

transcript.onScreen: Your next customer isn’t a person.
transcript.description: Tonal-dot hands reach toward a floating pair of headphones.
The word Agent appears in blue.
A shopper types this request into a ChatGPT-style conversation.

transcript.onScreen: Shoppers ask AI. AI shares the links. Before shoppers buy, AI chooses which stores they see.
transcript.description: The example response lists Soundcore P25i at $29.99, JLab Go Air Pop+ at $24.88 and TOZO T10 at $25.99, with retailer links. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity logos appear.

transcript.onScreen: Your store is Invisible. Agents can’t recommend what they can’t read. Outside the answer. Outside the sale.
transcript.description: A card labelled Your Store sits outside the answer with a Product data missing warning. The word Invisible dissolves.
The ecentic box and wordmark draw into view, then fill with colour.

A sample ecentic dashboard shows Diagnostics for low win rate and Listing Suggestions for Aura ANC Wireless Earbuds. The pointer selects Approve. The item moves from Pending to Published, and a message says Listing updated — Changes were published to your connected store.
The illustrative Overview dashboard animates a rising win-rate chart and a final overall win rate of 86%, alongside results for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
An example Shopify product page for Aura ANC Wireless Earbuds, priced at $39.99, transforms into a product card in the chat’s shopping results.

transcript.onScreen: Climb to the top of AI results. One catalog. Discovered across AI.
transcript.description: An ecentic Optimize control is shown beside ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Perplexity shopping mockups. Your Store moves from recommendation position #3 to #1 in each illustration, while a small car accelerates across the screen.

Product cards give way to a chat request: Show me the Aura earbuds. The response displays product photos, a $39.99 price and Buy now. The illustrated flow continues through Review your order, Complete purchase and Order confirmed — Your purchase is complete.
An illustrative Shopify Analytics chart rises to total sales of $48,920.00. This is a sample animation, not a reported customer result.

transcript.onScreen: Win the sale when AI does the shopping. Install now on Shopify and WooCommerce. ecentic.ai
transcript.description: The ecentic logo returns above the closing message, platform logos and website address.
